components.description: API plumbing for Mailwoman's HTTP surfaces — Hono node serve wrapper, OpenAPI emit helpers, shared wire atoms. Plumbing only: domain schemas live with their routes.

components.name: @mailwoman/core

components.name: @mailwoman/corpus
components.description: Mailwoman corpus pipeline: BIO-labeled dataset builder for the neural classifier.

components.name: @mailwoman/evidence
components.description: The typed-evidence contract — observation, relation and prior, and the epistemic-status axis that says what may be claimed about a value, kept separate from the mechanism that produced it.

components.description: Identity-crosswalk infrastructure for FCC broadband filers — builds and reads filer.db, linking FRN/Form 499/BDC provider_id/holding & management company identifiers with provenance and temporal (asOf) scoping (Phase 3a)

components.name: @mailwoman/flood
components.description: Environment Agency Flood Map for Planning (England) — acquisition, build, and the flood.db layer reader

components.name: @mailwoman/geographic-model
components.description: Stable geographic concepts, relations, mappings, source observations, derived facts, and their provenance — authored records compiled deterministically into runtime artifacts.

components.name: @mailwoman/kind-classifier
components.description: Stage 2.5 of the runtime pipeline — categorize inputs by query shape (postcode_only / locality_only / structured_address / intersection / po_box / landmark / vague). Rule-based for v1.

components.name: @mailwoman/locale-hint
components.description: Stage 2 of the runtime pipeline — derive a LocaleHint from QueryShape (script + known-format hits). Rule-based v1; trained classifier deferred to v0.6.0.

components.name: @mailwoman/map-tui
components.description: Terminal vector-tile map renderer — braille map frames for TUIs, from PMTiles.

components.name: @mailwoman/match
components.description: The geocode-first record matcher: block → score → cluster. This first reduce ships the string comparators (Jaro / Jaro-Winkler + an edit-distance fallback for compound surnames) that the Fellegi-Sunter scorer is built on.

components.name: @mailwoman/neural
components.description: Mailwoman neural classifier runtime: SentencePiece tokenizer + ONNX inference + decoder wiring.

components.name: @mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us
components.description: Mailwoman neural-classifier weights for locale 'en-us'. Data-only package — loaded by @mailwoman/neural at runtime.

components.name: @mailwoman/normalize
components.description: Stage 1 of the runtime pipeline — deterministic input preprocessing (Unicode NFC, punctuation, whitespace, abbreviation). Pure functions, no ML.

components.name: @mailwoman/phrase-grouper
components.description: Stage 2.7 of the runtime pipeline — propose coherent input units (boundary discovery) with a structural kind hypothesis + confidence. Rule-based v1 (port of v1 section/sub-section logic); learned 1-2M-param span proposer reserved for v0.5.1.

components.name: @mailwoman/poi-taxonomy
components.description: POI category taxonomy + phrase lexicon — Overture category snapshot, infrastructure extension namespace, and the synonym table mapping query phrases ('drinking fountain', 'fiber hut') to category ids.

components.name: @mailwoman/query-shape
components.description: Cheap structural priors for the runtime pipeline: character class, segmentation, known-format detection. Pure functions, no ML.

components.name: @mailwoman/record
components.description: Lean, plain-TypeScript record schema + per-field normalizers for the geocode-first matcher. Address-first: the canonical PostalAddress record composes parser components, the formatter's match key, and a resolved geocode; organization + contact records build on the same canonical record.

components.name: @mailwoman/registry
components.description: The geocode-first record-matching application: resolve messy contact/organization records into canonical, geocoded entities (block → score → cluster) and export them as GeoJSON for spatial analysis. The clinic-funding use case mailwoman was built for.

components.name: @mailwoman/resolver
components.description: The address resolver: walk an AddressTree, decorate nodes with gazetteer-supplied coordinates + attribution. Backend-agnostic (any ResolverBackend), with the span-rescore + postcode-consistency changes. Lifted out of @mailwoman/core so it can depend on @mailwoman/spatial (haversine) + @mailwoman/codex (USPS directionals) instead of reinventing them; the type contract stays in core so the pipeline composes it without a cycle.

components.name: @mailwoman/resolver-wof-sqlite
components.description: Who's On First SQLite resolver — FTS5-backed PlaceLookup that resolves text queries to WOF place IDs + coordinates. Optional dependency for callers who want geocoding.

components.name: @mailwoman/sentencepiece-wasm
components.description: google/sentencepiece v0.2.2 compiled to WASM with a native-offsets binding — the tokenizer core for @mailwoman/neural. Single-file ESM (wasm embedded), no runtime deps; per-piece byte offsets come from SentencePiece itself instead of TS-side reconstruction.
